# Current-format ingestion fixtures

Frozen before adapter implementation. Content, timestamps and IDs are synthetic. Codex shapes come from the independently captured 12-case corpus (26 turns, 28 human messages); Copilot shapes come from local version-1 copilot-agent events.jsonl. No private source content is committed.

expected.json is hand-authored from source semantics, not generated by Sensei. Unknown records deliberately require partial coverage. The second human message belongs to the same turn. Command exit 1 is retained as an outcome; it does not assert friction. Wrapper success and leaf failure remain separate identities.

Transport tests derive compressed, partial and interrupted files from these fixed bytes. Original legacy fixtures and private corpus expectations remain unchanged.
